description: This PHP source file contains utility functions for SuiteCRM installation and configuration, including language pack management, database setup, logging, and hooks for custom installation steps.

methods.name: installerHook
methods.description: Calls a custom function if it exists, based on the first parameter, and returns its result or 'undefined' if not found.

methods.name: parseAcceptLanguage
methods.description: Returns the lowercase language encoding from the HTTP_ACCEPT_LANGUAGE header.

methods.name: commitLanguagePack
methods.description: Copies or removes language pack files to/from the system, updating configuration accordingly.

methods.name: commitPatch
methods.description: Installs patches by unzipping and executing pre/post install scripts, and recording upgrade history.

methods.name: commitModules
methods.description: Installs modules or language packs from upgrade zip files, executing manifests and scripts.

methods.name: updateUpgradeHistory
methods.description: Creates entries in the upgrade history for installed language packs.

methods.name: removeLanguagePack
methods.description: Removes language pack files and updates configuration, keeping zip in cache.

methods.name: writeSugarConfig
methods.description: Writes the current $sugar_config array to config.php.

methods.name: uninstallLangPack
methods.description: Removes a language from the configuration.

methods.name: getLanguagePackName
methods.description: Retrieves the language pack name from a language file.

methods.name: getInstalledLangPacks
methods.description: Returns an HTML table of installed language packs with options to uninstall.

methods.name: getSugarConfigLanguageArray
methods.description: Returns a string with language pack ID, name, and version from manifest files.

methods.name: getInstallDbInstance
methods.description: Returns a database instance based on session setup variables.

methods.name: getDbConnection
methods.description: Establishes and returns a database connection using session parameters.

methods.name: handleDbCreateSugarUser
methods.description: Creates a SugarCRM database user if not an admin.

methods.name: handleDbCharsetCollation
methods.description: Sets charset and collation for MySQL databases.

methods.name: handleDbCreateDatabase
methods.description: Creates a new database for SugarCRM.

methods.name: handleLog4Php
methods.description: Deprecated function, does nothing.

methods.name: installLog
methods.description: Logs installation steps and errors to install.log file.

methods.name: handleSugarConfig
methods.description: Generates and writes the main configuration file config.php based on session variables.
